item.title: Remove Write permission from validator agent
item.intent: Validators must report problems, never fix them — Write access lets the validator silently modify files instead of failing the sprint and giving the developer targeted retry context.
item.description: PERMS_VALIDATOR currently includes Write (Bash,Read,Write,Glob,Grep). The validator only needs Write for result.json (completion contract). Remove Write from PERMS_VALIDATOR. The validator can still write result.json via Bash (echo/jq to file). This enforces the separation: developers fix, validators judge.
steps: Verify the validator can still write result.json via Bash tool
Update CONFIGURATION.md if it documents validator permissions

acceptanceCriteria.text: Validator permissions do not include Write tool
Validator permissions still include Bash for running commands and writing result.json
